source_excerpt: Careful dissection of the G. kuroshimensis flowers at different stages revealed that their pollinia fragment into massulae before the flowers matured. The flowers were also found to have degenerated rostellums, which allowed the massulae to drop directly onto the surface of the stigma, confirming the obligate self-pollinating nature of this species.
